counting_unit: A deduplicated independent study ID; a DOI observed in two catalogues is not two studies. Retractions and supplements must be resolved before admission.
reference_corpus: OpenAlex historical snapshot, with frozen candidate admission rule applied identically to all years. Crossref, patents, arXiv and reports are separate enrichment evidence.
window: 6 to 10 consecutive completed years as of the saved date. R is the final 3 years, B the immediately preceding 3. Older years are novelty context. The current incomplete year is excluded.
growth_ratio: G = (R + 1) / (B + 1). Raw ratio R/B is null when B=0; the label is appearance in the observed corpus, never infinite growth.
recent_slope: Theil-Sen median of all 3 pairwise yearly slopes within the final 3 completed years.
growth_gates: Reference history is exhaustive, comparable, uncapped, resolved and free of date conflicts
At least 2 recent years have >= 1 admitted independent study
Specific technological mechanism, not a broad topic or uncertain grouping
Problem, advantage and case all have grounded supporting claims

components.growth: clip(50 * log2(G), 0, 100); null if reference history is incomplete or incomparable
components.persistence: 100 * active_recent_years / 3; null if reference history is incomplete or incomparable
components.novelty: Rubric below, supported by an explicit novelty claim, checks of earlier analogues AND terminology changes; otherwise null
components.independence: min(100, 25 * number_of_verified_disjoint_research_groups) across recent studies. Only when every recent study is accounted for; otherwise null. Source catalogues, author names and institutions alone are not independent teams.
components.application: Rubric below supported by an explicit application claim; otherwise null. These levels describe documentary evidence and are not TRL, readiness or commercial success.

missing_policy: Never renormalize weights or substitute zero/average for an unknown component. priority_score is null if any component is unknown. Report [sum of known weighted values, sum of known weighted values + missing weights] as an uncertainty bound, not as measured score endpoints.

categories.confirmed_trend: Every growth gate passes AND checked novelty rubric is >= 50
categories.renewed_interest: Every growth gate passes AND checked novelty rubric is zero
categories.established_topic: Complete reference history and checked novelty rubric is zero, but at least one growth gate fails; no market maturity is implied
categories.early_signal: All other candidates, including confirmed growth with unverified novelty

confidence.high: All growth gates pass and all score components are known
confidence.medium: All growth gates pass but at least one score component is unknown
confidence.low: At least one growth gate fails

quality: insufficient_data if R=0; otherwise complete if reference history is complete/comparable without date conflicts; otherwise partial. This is data completeness, independent of confirmed growth and confidence.
rounding: Only displayed components, scores and interval endpoints are rounded to 2 decimal places using decimal ROUND_HALF_UP. Gates use unrounded values. The weighted score uses unrounded components.
ranking: Default: confirmed_trend only, up to 15; descending conservative priority lower bound, high/medium/low confidence, descending recent count, ascending stable candidate ID. Never pad with unsupported cards.
limitations: This score is a transparent prioritization heuristic, not a probability, market forecast or claim of worldwide first invention.
Structured validation cannot prove scientific truth. Grounding and novelty rubrics require a separately verified assessment; an LLM saying supported is insufficient.
Thresholds and rubric weights are provisional until independent quality evaluation. Test fixtures verify arithmetic and rejection behavior, not real-world precision.
